t: You're at Redcliffe Square in Brompton, in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. The square and its gardens were built between 1864 and 1878 as part of the large Gunter estate. Two people connected to it are named here. Monica Harrison, who lived from 1897 to 1983, was an English mezzo-soprano, born in the square. She was the third of four sisters who were all respected classical musicians and had started out as child prodigies. Lady Vanessa Pelham, born in 1961, also lived here.
